answer: Admission requires a refundable bond in a time-locked vault plus an in-person intake no remote farm can batch. At the desk, an operator fires a calibrated lamp at an umber ceramic coupon issued only to that applicant; the scatter fingerprint is hashed on-ledger and must match at later audits, so a photo fails. The applicant also gives a live whisper of a fresh nonce into a staffed microphone, timestamped and signed before the bond can unlock. A sybil therefore pays a new bond, a uniquely fired ceramic, and a new attended recording for every fake seat, and any mismatch burns the stake.
